svg.title: Mark — (2,5) torus knot
svg.desc: theta = 2t, rho = 2 + cos(5t). Exact five-fold symmetry by construction. Painted in depth order so the over/under is correct; revealed in parameter order so the curve draws along its own length. Reveal 120ms per chunk (--motion-fast), stagger 720ms (2 x --motion-gesture), total 840ms. GENERATED — see imagery/knot.json.
